command: python run_benchmark.py --exact gurobi --solvers sa --baselines greedy,lp,benders --benders-time-limit 60 --benders-max-iterations 1000 --case testcases/50.planarflow:5:auto --case testcases/50_0.15.erdosflow:5:auto --case testcases/50_5.2dnnflow:4:auto --out results/classical_baselines_sample.csv

protocol.sa_sweeps_note: Installed dwave-samplers default; caller does not override num_sweeps.
protocol.sa_postprocessing: Existing best-20 sample scoring and greedy repair.
protocol.timing_note: Gurobi_total_time_sec, SA_total_time_sec, Greedy_time_sec, LP_time_sec + LP_repair_time_sec, and Benders_time_sec include construction/solve/scoring for each method. Reference_time_sec separately records exact references and auto-lambda calibration. File loading, environment setup and process startup excluded; usual diagnostic output included. The same process performs references first, then Gurobi, SA, greedy, LP and Benders.
protocol.scope: Three small existing slide cases, one per family. No hardware, decomposition, Lagrangian or random-greedy pass. Not a full family comparison, hardness study, scaling result or speedup claim.
